```sql
WITH filtered_loans AS (
    SELECT
        "Loan Amount (Rs)"
    FROM "shg_loan_register"
    WHERE "Disbursement Date" LIKE '2024%'
),
total_amount AS (
    SELECT SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total
    FROM filtered_loans
),
purpose_totals AS (
    SELECT
        "Purpose",
        SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS purpose_amount
    FROM filtered_loans
    GROUP BY "Purpose"
)
SELECT
    pt."Purpose",
    pt.purpose_amount,
    (pt.purpose_amount * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.total, 0)) AS share_of_total
FROM purpose_totals pt
CROSS JOIN total_amount t
ORDER BY pt.purpose_amount DESC;
```
